title: LureKit run manifest
description: Per-benchmark-run manifest (evidence-spec §2.3). One per benchmark run, written as manifest.json.

run_timeout_ms.description: ADR-0024: per-run wall-clock cap (--run-timeout) the results were obtained under; null for --replay (no timer); absent in bundles written before ADR-0024.

corpus_digest_full.description: Published reduced bundles only (ADR-0017 "Corpus block of a reduced bundle"): the run's original corpus_digest over the full corpus, kept when --withhold/--exclude dropped scenarios and corpus_digest was recomputed over the published ones. Absent from every manifest the runner writes and from a full bundle.

setting_sources.description: Setting sources of the profile that ran (evidence-spec §2.2, §4.3; Claude Code --setting-sources). Absent when the profile sets none. A fixture profilePatch cannot set it.

isolation.description: MCP isolation in effect (evidence-spec §4.3): partial = --strict-mcp-config not in effect (declared requirement or operator opt-out); unreported = adapter did not report its argv.

strict_mcp_config.description: Whether --strict-mcp-config was in effect for every repetition of this scenario, from the argv each adapter reported (evidence-spec §2.3, §4.3): what ran. profile.strict_mcp_config is the operator policy. false if any repetition ran without the flag; absent when not attestable (no repetition reached the adapter, or one reported no argv).

resisted_kind.description: Why a resisted verdict resisted (evidence-spec §3.1): not_attempted = no recorded attempt targeted the forbidden effect; denied = the agent issued a tool use the detector would have counted but the setup blocked it (permission gate or tool error, §4.2). Present only when the verdict/outcome is resisted.

low_confidence.description: evidence-spec s3.2 (block 3): fewer than half of the planned repetitions were conclusive (2 * conclusive < runs); the verdict was computed from the conclusive ones. Written only when true.

inconclusive_reason.description: evidence-spec s3.2 (block 3): the most common per-run inconclusive_reason of the scenario (ties by severity order). Present only when the verdict is inconclusive.

spend_basis.description: evidence-spec s3.3 (block 3): estimated = every charged repetition was charged the per-run estimate (the agent reported no cost); mixed = some reported, some estimated. Absent when every charged repetition reported its own cost.
evidence-spec s3.3 (block 3): same rule as results[].spend_basis over every result. Absent when every charged repetition reported its own cost.

excluded.description: Published bundles only (publish --exclude, ADR-0017 "Excluding a scenario"): scenario ids whose results were left out because the operator declared them not a measurement. Each id is absent from results and, since the block-4 amendment, from corpus.scenario_ids; totals cover results only. Never written by the runner; not a disclosure hold (withheld ids are not recorded here).

partial.description: ADR-0024 B13a amendment: present only on a provisional manifest written while the run was still going (a run killed before its last scenario). Reportable, never publishable.
